visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male creator with dark hair and a bright smile, wearing a clean white t-shirt, holds a large, black, multi-slot palette filled with various SUQQU blush pans. The setting is a brightly lit, professional white studio background. He moves the palette slightly, causing the silver cases to catch the light. (2) The scene shifts to a closer view of the blush collection. The creator's hands are visible as he gestures toward the rows of gradients, including pinks, oranges, and purples. Each pan is encased in a sleek metallic frame. Text overlays appear at the top and center of the frame. (3) The creator is seen actively assembling the large palette. He uses his fingers to carefully lift individual rectangular blush inserts from their smaller original cases and place them into the larger storage unit. The lighting remains flat and bright, typical of a beauty tutorial. (4) Holding a fluffy makeup brush, the creator demonstrates the product. He picks up pigment from the large palette and applies it to his cheek with gentle, sweeping motions. His facial expression is focused and satisfied. A comic-style overlay with a grape candy image appears briefly. (5) The creator holds the completed large palette and a smaller original one to compare. He waves his hand in a dismissive but humorous gesture. Gold sparkling graphics are superimposed over the palette as he smiles and continues to address the camera directly in a close-up shot.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic male speaker talking in Mandarin, accompanied by a fast-tempo, upbeat electronic synth track. The speaker's tone is highly positive and engaging. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect coincides with the appearance of text on screen. The BGM maintains a consistent four-on-the-floor beat, driving the energy of the monologue. (3) Subtle mechanical clicking sounds of makeup cases being opened and closed are audible as the speaker describes his process. His speech rate remains fast and enthusiastic. (4) A comic 'squeak' or 'boing' sound effect is used during a meme-style edit. The BGM remains steady in the background without any noticeable pauses. (5) The speaker's volume increases slightly as he shows off the final product. A 'shimmer' or 'sparkle' SFX plays as he demonstrates the blush. (6) The audio concludes with a final enthusiastic phrase from the speaker and a short musical stinger as the track fades out quickly.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Introduction -> Problem (carrying many small palettes) -> Solution (assembling a custom large palette) -> Demonstration -> Recommendation.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to showcase a customized SUQQU blush palette and the process of creating it. The creator, Kai, uses high energy and humor to demonstrate the convenience and aesthetic appeal of consolidating individual blushes into one professional case, effectively acting as an endorsement for the brand and his professional storage technique.
